newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila firm buys 7,500T wheat, 7,500T soybean.
newsitem.headline: Manila firm buys 7,500T wheat, 7,500T soybean.

text.p: A Philippine flour mill bought on Wednesday 7,500 tonnes of U.S. western white wheat at $4.02 a bushel and 7,500 tonnes of soybean at $8.92 a bushel, traders who joined the tender said.
The company decided to defer buying another 7,500 tonnes of dark northern spring wheat with 14 percent protein content due to high prices, said a senior Manila trader.
Manila mills had sought a total 90,000 tonnes of wheat but it was not known if any other deals were done.
